content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, thank you for sharing the agreement. Before moving forward, I would like to propose a small adjustment to the relevant clause: - Regarding the payment schedule, the current wording could delay payment for up to nearly two months depending on the invoice date, so I propose updating it so that all payments are due within thirty (30) days of receipt of the invoice. Please let me know if this works for you. Best regards,
